concern: The person is distressed and worried that her committed partner of two years has lost sexual interest in her, a pattern that ended his past relationships, and she wants to know how he can get past it.
first_advice: "What are your own views on the meaning of sex in a relationship? Knowing this will help you be better able to collaborate with your boyfriend on finding ways..."
acknowledged_before_advice: Only a situational reflection: the counselor wonders how long "anymore" will last and notes that he will now face staying in a sexless committed relationship. Nothing names, validates or empathizes with her feelings of hurt, worry or rejection.
label: premature
